concepts.name: A-refined-terminal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity, polished game UI concept as a 1600x1000 landscape image. The input screenshot is the REFERENCE and edit base for the actual Caves of Ooo game: preserve its dark green voxel-pixel world, right-hand vitals/log sidebar, and bottom ten-slot skill bar. Replace the yellow-text 'Flaming Hands' popup completely with a redesigned EXAMINE reader. The main subject is the new dialog; the surrounding game may be gently dimmed but must remain recognizable and must not be redesigned. The popup fits entirely within the gameplay column; never covers the right sidebar or bottom skill bar. Keep pixel/terminal aesthetics, sharp rectangular geometry, carefully aligned monospace typography of normal proportions, ample line spacing, ivory body text, warm amber subject, muted teal secondary text. Readability on a 1280x800 Steam Deck is crucial: main body visually equivalent to 20-22px at that size. Restrained original roguelike aesthetic sympathetic to Caves of Qud, with the existing 3D-pixel world. No rounded mobile cards, glossy gradients, neon bloom, parchment scrolls, sans-serif dashboard, minimap, quest markers, rarity labels, invented stats, new gameplay action buttons, or extra controls.
Show this SAME illustrative damaged world object in every concept. Exact text, prioritizing clean spelling and natural wrapping:
eyebrow "EXAMINE"
title "Clay-lined catch well"
state "DAMAGED LINING"
condition paragraph "A split in the fired lining lets the drawn water drain through the rim."
description "A shallow catch well beside the growing beds. Its fired-clay lining forms a basin beneath a broad stone rim."
facts "Material: Masonry" and "Repair: 2 fire clay"
Fixed footer "A Close" and "B Back"; small muted "1 / 1". Render A/B as outlined controller button glyphs. This is a read-only inspect window, so Repair is factual text, NOT a repair button. No pages button on this single-page sample. If imagery is requested below, depict a SMALL original chunky pixel-voxel stone-ring well with orange clay lining, never a photorealistic object.
The same design shell should plausibly collapse to a short one-line level-up notice, but show only the examine popup here. No mockup labels, comparison boards, captions or watermark in the image itself.
Direction A: REFINED TERMINAL. One centered, compact, horizontal reading panel roughly 690x400 at the input screenshot scale. Single-column text with generous 24px padding. Near-black blue-green interior, an exceptionally clean thin double-line muted jade frame with restrained squared corners. Header has a small well glyph left of the title, tiny EXAMINE above; horizontal divider. A narrow dark-amber state strip draws the eye first, then clear condition and description paragraphs. Two compact factual rows separated from prose; footer divided by a single teal hairline. Highly restrained, elegant text-first evolution of the current popup. Larger type, dramatically better whitespace and hierarchy; no oversized object illustration.
